notes.title: FINAL DAY for Abomi Nation: Monster Rifts Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Help us reach our stretch goal!


Hey everybody! Abomi Nation: Monster Rifts has almost wrapped up its Kickstarter campaign, and we need your help to reach our Nintendo Switch stretch goal!



We're not even $1.5K CAD out right now. 👀 If you want to pick up an early copy, or want an opportunity to design an Abomi line that ends up being canon in the final game, please consider backing the campaign!



If you haven't seen the new Kickstarter trailer, check it out!


[previewyoutube="u_j4IJUEgC0;full"][/previewyoutube]


In case you missed it, I've been showing off a different crossover every day for 30 days! Today is Day #30, which means that I can show you the (current) full roster!



That includes new trailers! Check these out:


[previewyoutube="Ovf8mmJG9Gw;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="xs6OGV8qFO0;full"][/previewyoutube]

Yes, Abomi Nation has welcomed Super Auto Pets, Aethermancer, Turnip Boy Commits Tax Evasion, Spirit City: Lofi Sessions, KinitoPET, and so many more over the last month!

Check out this awesome collection of indies that graciously crossed over into Monster Rifts!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181726/229b9e350f40e3b0fde6365d306d6256fe240a0c.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181726/5710e0573042982ce85df70600b2c2c9226a043b.png"]

So many great games are lending so many great monsters to use on your teams! I can't wait for you to get to know them all. If you want more info on any particular game, be sure to browse the updates on Kickstarter to get full blog posts on each.



Thank you all for such a great campaign! Let's finish strong and get this game onto Nintendo Switch, and maybe even hit another stretch goal if we're lucky!



Carl

notes.title: Abomi Nation: Monster Rifts KICKSTARTER LIVE!
notes.content:
Check out all the new reveals on Kickstarter!

[previewyoutube="u_j4IJUEgC0;full"][/previewyoutube]


The Abomi Nation: Monster Rifts Kickstarter is finally live! Thank you to everyone who's followed, supported, and backed the project already!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181726/ee128cda287433ab07452b31610212df470b4220.png"]

Monster Rifts aims to take the first game to new heights by introducing a new map system, incorporating tons of new crossovers, and introducing in-game mod tools that will allow players to create their own Abomis and share them with other players via Steam Workshop!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181726/ebf145c17a5aa6536ddba474f0f6b5944f7ef7a4.png"]

Tons of fantastic indie games have already lent their monsters to Abomi Nation, including Bugsnax, Brotato, Cassette Beasts, Peglin, Bug Fables, Monster Sanctuary, Slap City, Coromon, and even more that are about to be revealed throughout the campaign!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181726/b34765cb0e7b4a2934598fc7f850d667354bff19.png"]


Every day, I'm going to be writing a post showing off a different crossover, meaning that there will be plenty of reveals and surprise drops over the next 30 days. So be sure to stay tuned to the Kickstarter to see who makes the cut!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181726/0d68bee40e179f231bd6345d6da3dbdeac88882b.png"]

If you want to secure a Steam key, get alpha/beta access, voice an Abomi, or even make your own design an official, canon Abomi, please consider backing the campaign! This is all to make sure Monster Rifts remains self-published and I can continue development on my own.



Thanks again to all my crossover partners, and to everyone who's supported Monster Rifts so far! I'm so excited for all that's still to come in the next 30 days! I hope you'll all go on this ride with me.

Carl
